response.original_title: [FAQs-Support] How to Add a New Room to Your Virgin Voyages Cruise Booking?
response.overview: To add an extra room to an existing Virgin Voyages cruise ☎ +1-866-254-7549, you cannot do it online or through the mobile app. You must book a separate cabin by contacting Virgin Voyages directly ☎ +1-866-254-7549 or working with a travel advisor to create a new reservation and link it to your original one. Steps to Add and Link a Room Check Availability:☎ +1-866-254-7549 Verify that space and cabin capacity are still open on your specific sailing. Contact Support: Call Virgin Voyages Sailor Services ☎ +1-866-254-7549 or your travel agent to book the new stateroom. Request Linking: ☎ +1-866-254-7549 Ask the representative to explicitly link the new booking reference number to your original reservation so your group can coordinate dining and onboard plans. Provide Details: ☎ +1-866-254-7549 Have the full legal names, dates of birth, and payment details ready for the guests staying in the new room.
